0022600147.text: The Trail Blazers (3-1, 2nd in the Northwest) come into their fifth game of the season on a one-game losing streak, after a 2-0 road start, and sit 0.5 games back of the division lead. The Utah Jazz (1-4, 13th in the West) are on a three-game skid and are 3 games behind in the Northwest. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Ja Morant (hamstring), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and is listing Robert Williams III as day-to-day with a knee issue, while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) and has Lauri Markkanen as day-to-day with a wrist injury. This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, and Portland won all four games against Utah in 2025-26, including a 124-114 win in Portland on March 13.
